name: Evan
source:
Evan was once a journalist working for a newspaper, but is now one of the prisoners at the same penitentiary as [url=/c10893]Guys[/url]. He has a youthful energy about him, and isn't the type to forgive anything unjust. He found out the truth about a certain bribery case, and like Guys, was falsely accused and subsequently imprisoned. Evan often provides valuable, rational advice to Guys, and is always there to calmly cheer Guys up.

[Based on the [URL=http://www.langmaor.com/l01/l0102.htm]official website's character profiles[/URL].]
